notes: Type-led: every picture slot has a typeset or empty fallback and no text ever stands on a picture. The whole page is the client's accent colour with one ink, so the accent must be a colour the client accepts edge to edge (a mid-tone accent is lightened or darkened until the ink reads 7:1). A long name is set in two lines. With no photographs offer it only to a client who has real copy (a statement, sentences on the links, a menu or hours): then it holds; with thin copy it is an almost empty coloured page.
drops (as written): hero.primary and hero.secondary as buttons (booking and menu stand in the bar, the tiles and the contact block)
drops (as written): place.since outside the stamp
drops (as written): steps.items (place.spaces is read instead)
drops (as written): links[].d on a phone when the tile has a picture
motif (as written): none (places: the client's own photographs only; the page is one flat ground in the client's accent)

best_with: 2 upright photographs at least 1200 px high (the two frames at the window's edge), 3 or more dishes (any size from 330x440), one photograph per room; `page` on photographs lets a tile and a menu part take the picture that belongs to it
